meta.name: parallel-debugging
meta.description: Debug complex issues using competing hypotheses with parallel investigation, evidence collection, and root cause arbitration. Use this skill when debugging bugs with multiple potential causes, performing root cause analysis, or organizing parallel investigation workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行验证多个假设,揪出复杂 bug 的根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对原因不明的复杂 bug,想用并行调查法快速定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Parallelize hypothesis testing to pinpoint root causes of complex bugs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're stuck on a tricky bug with multiple possible causes and want a systematic way to find the root cause

howto.what: Claude 会为一个 bug 同时提出多个竞争假设,按逻辑、数据、状态、集成、资源、环境六类失败模式并行排查,收集带 file:line 的证据并标注置信度,最后裁定根因并做修复校验。
howto.when: 当 bug 有多种可能原因、初步排查没定位到问题,或需要带证据的系统性根因分析时触发。

say.text: 这个 bug 可能有好几种原因,帮我用竞争假设排查
say.note: 会生成并分类多组假设

say.text: 帮我做根因分析,证据要标出 file:line
say.note: 证据会带文件与行号引用

say.text: 这两个假设都成立,帮我排序看是不是复合问题
say.note: 按置信度和证据数量排序

howto.what_en: Claude forms competing hypotheses for a bug, investigates them in parallel across six failure-mode categories, collects evidence cited as file:line with confidence levels, then arbitrates the root cause and validates the fix.
howto.when_en: Use when a bug has multiple plausible causes, initial debugging attempts didn't identify it, or you need systematic root-cause analysis backed by evidence.

say_en.text: This bug might have several causes — investigate it with competing hypotheses.
Do a root cause analysis on this error; cite evidence as file:line.
say_en.note: Evidence includes file and line references.

say_en.text: Both hypotheses hold — rank them and check if this is a compound issue.
say_en.note: Ranks by confidence and evidence count.
